ThingDef.label: shatterjaw beetle
ThingDef.description: One of the most dangerous inhabitants of the crystal caves, the shatterjaw hunt with their large mandibles, crushing and cutting prey to pieces before feeding.

ThingDef.label: gembug
ThingDef.description: A plated crawler of the lanternstone voids, running on hydrocarbon rather than blood - what fills it is a cold waxy oil that will not freeze however deep the cave goes. Its shell grows in facets out of the same slow crystallisation that grew the caverns, so a gembug reads as a chip of the wall until it moves. Cut one and it weeps thin paraffin, not red.

ThingDef.label: bovine grub
ThingDef.description: A large grub originally from Caveworlds, this bug is often kept in farms for the milk-like substance it produces as an adult. It is the larval form of the bovine beetle.

ThingDef.label: drinker
ThingDef.description: A pale, near-silent flier that drains blood into swollen storage sacs beneath its carapace using a razor-sharp proboscis. Strangely, a meal from a warm-blooded surface creature poisons it — it dies rapidly afterward.

ThingDef.label: moss grub
ThingDef.description: A large beetle commonly found in dark, damp places, it feeds off low underbrush in caverns. While not the best source of meat, it works when little else is available.

ThingDef.label: soulchime
ThingDef.description: A stubby larva-like creature that builds armor from crystal shards it gathers off the ground. It emits a powerful psychic stun on anyone who approaches too closely and alarms it, but a tamed one has a soothing effect on those nearby.

ThingDef.label: glowbulb
ThingDef.description: A pale-blue slug of the deep voids, lit from within by the slow burn of its own hydrocarbon sap - the yellow fluid under its skin is a light oil, not blood, and it will not freeze however far the cave runs down. Easily spotted in any dark environment by that steady glow, and by whatever else is hunting in the dark.

ThingDef.label: megapleura
ThingDef.description: A relative of the trilobite beetle, the megapleura has grown to massive proportions while living deep within the Rim's crust. While odd in appearance, it is largely harmless.

ThingDef.label: shatterjaw grub
ThingDef.description: While its adult form can bite a man in half, this weak, squishy grub is incapable of such a task.

ThingDef.label: grabber
ThingDef.description: A small room-sized blob of pale yellow substance under a glass-like carapace, moving on many small legs. Its single great pincer-ending arm can hold a victim fast and slowly crush them.
